# Introduction

This document details temperature mortality curves for the CCUH cities using neighborhood level modifiers.

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Libraries and plot theming."

# Libraries
library("tidyverse")
library("patchwork")
library("lubridate")
library("glue")
library("dlnm"); library("gnm")

# ggplot2 theming
theme_set(theme_classic())
theme_update(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
             plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
             strip.background = element_blank(),
             strip.text = element_text(size = 12))

# Helper function for getting MMT
get_cen <- function(crosspred) {
  if(!is.null(crosspred$fit)) {
    crosspred$predvar[which.min(crosspred$fit)]
  } else if(!is.null(crosspred$allfit)) {
    crosspred$predvar[which.min(crosspred$allfit)]
  } else {
    print("Unable to locate minimum.")
  }
}

# Helper function for extracting reduced curve
get_df_RRs <- function(pred) {
  tibble(Temperature = pred$predvar,
         RR = pred$RRfit,
         RR_low = pred$RRlow,
         RR_high = pred$RRhigh)
}
```

# Analysis

The first step in our analysis is to add a `strata` variable (age-category:nbhd:year:month:day-of-week) for use in fitting a conditional quasi-Poisson DLNM.

```{r}
#| code-summary: "Prepare data for analysis."

# We add a strata column to fit a conditional model
# We add a group column to ensure our cross-basis is correctly calculated
# We add the under_65 and over_65 to facilitate easy manipulation of which group
# is the "reference group" in our interaction DLNM models.
df <- df |> 
  mutate(strata = paste(nbhd_geoid, age_category,
                        year(date), month(date), wday(date, label = TRUE),
                        sep = ":"),
         under_65 = ifelse(age_category == "<65", 1, 0),
         over_65 = ifelse(age_category == "65+", 1, 0),
         group = paste(nbhd_geoid, age_category, sep = ":"),
         across(c(age_category, nbhd_geoid, strata, group), factor))

# Cities of interest
city_names <- unique(df$city_name)

# Countries of interest
country_names <- unique(df$iso2)
```

## Curves by City

```{r}
#| code-summary: "City-level analysis pooled at the nbhd-level."

# Model
model_by_city <-
  map(city_names, \(ID) {
    
    # Aggregated TS
    df0 <- df |>
      filter(city_name == ID, !is.na(popwt_temp)) |> # SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS, death > 0) 
      mutate(across(c(strata, group), droplevels))
    
    # Specify knots placement
    var_knots <- quantile(df0$popwt_temp, c(.1, .75, .9), na.rm = TRUE)
    lag_knots <- logknots(21, nk = 5)
    
    # Specify cross-basis
    cbt <- crossbasis(df0$popwt_temp, lag = 21,
                      argvar = list(fun = "ns", knots = var_knots),
                      arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = lag_knots),
                      group = df0$group)
    
    # Specify interaction terms
    cb_age1 <- cbt * df0$under_65
    cb_age2 <- cbt * df0$over_65
    
    # Fit city-specific model
    model <- gnm(death ~ cbt,
                 family = quasipoisson(),
                 #offset = log(POP),
                 eliminate = strata,
                 data = df0)
    
    model_age1 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_age2) # Reference group under_65
    model_age2 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_age1) # Reference group over_65
    
    # Get exposure response curve/surface by city
    # pred_age1 <- crossreduce(cbt, model_age1, cen = median(df0$popwt_temp))
    # pred_age2 <- crossreduce(cbt, model_age2, cen = median(df0$popwt_temp))
    
    list(pred_age1 = crossreduce(cbt, model_age1, cen = quantile(df0$popwt_temp, .75)),
         pred_age2 = crossreduce(cbt, model_age2, cen = quantile(df0$popwt_temp, .75)))
    
  })

# Values for plotting
min_temp <- min(df$popwt_temp)
max_temp <- max(df$popwt_temp)

min_RR <- min(map_dbl(model_by_city, \(x) min(c(x$pred_age1$RRlow, x$pred_age2$RRlow))))
max_RR

# Create list of plots
plot_by_city <-
  map2(model_by_city, city_names, \(pred_list, name_l1) {
    # Data frame for plotting RRs
    df_plot <- bind_rows(under_65 = get_df_RRs(pred_list$pred_age1),
                         over_65 = get_df_RRs(pred_list$pred_age2),
                         .id = "age")
    
    df0 <- df |>
      filter(salid1 == city_IDs[name_l1], !is.na(temp_pw))
    
    # Plot curve and histogram of observed temperatures by city
    p_curve <- df_plot |>
      ggplot(aes(x = Temperature)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = RR_low, ymax = RR_high, fill = age), alpha = .2) +
      geom_line(aes(y = RR, color = age)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1) +
      scale_color_viridis_d() +
      scale_fill_viridis_d() +
      scale_y_continuous(transform = "log", labels = \(x) round(x, 2)) + # c(0.85, 1.8)
      labs(title = glue("{name_l1}"))

    p_hist <- df0 |>
      ggplot(aes(temp_pw)) +
      geom_histogram(alpha = .2, bins = 35) +
      labs(title = "Observed Temperatures",
           x = "Temperature",
           y = "Count (in 1000s)") +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) {x/1000})

    p_curve / p_hist
  })
```

```{r}
                      argvar = list(fun = "ns", knots = var_knots),
                      arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = lag_knots),
                      group = df0$group)
    
    # Specify interaction terms
    cb_age1 <- cbt * df0$under_65
    cb_age2 <- cbt * df0$over_65
    
    # Fit city-specific model
    model <- gnm(death ~ cbt,
                 family = quasipoisson(),
                 #offset = log(POP),
                 eliminate = strata,
                 data = df0)
    
    model_age1 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_age2) # Reference group under_65
    model_age2 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_age1) # Reference group over_65
    
    model_age1_low
    model_age2_high
    
    # Get exposure response curve/surface by city
    # pred_age1 <- crossreduce(cbt, model_age1, cen = median(df0$popwt_temp))

interaction_model_by_city_age <- function(variable) { 
  map(df_l1_age, \(df0) {
    # Specify knots placement
    var_knots <- quantile(df0$temp_pw, c(.1, .75, .9), na.rm = TRUE)
    lag_knots <- logknots(21, nk = 5)
    
    # Specify cross-basis
    cbt <- crossbasis(df0$temp_pw, lag = 21,
                      argvar = list(fun = "ns", knots = var_knots),
                      arglag = list(fun = "ns", knots = lag_knots),
                      group = droplevels(df0$salid2))
    
    # Fit city-specific model
    model <- gnm(death ~ cbt,
                 family = quasipoisson(),
                 #offset = log(POP),
                 eliminate = strata,
                 data = df0)
    
    # Interaction CBs Greenspace
    intval <- quantile(df0[[variable]], c(.1, .9))
    cb_int1 <- cbt * (df0[[variable]] - intval[1])
    cb_int2 <- cbt * (df0[[variable]] - intval[2])
    
    # Fit interaction models
    model_int1 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_int1)
    model_int2 <- update(model, . ~ . + cb_int2)
    
    # Predication
    pred_int1 <- crossreduce(cbt, model_int1, cen = median(df0$temp_pw))
    pred_int2 <- crossreduce(cbt, model_int2, cen = median(df0$temp_pw))
    
    list(pred_int1 = crossreduce(cbt, model_int2, cen = get_cen(pred_int1)),
         pred_int2 = crossreduce(cbt, model_int2, cen = get_cen(pred_int2)))
    
  })}
```
